verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS equity-management platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains only marketing and product-feature descriptions, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no evidence of API versioning or a deprecation policy. The llms.txt file describes products, not APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
